title: TaladHub Development: From idea to a comprehensive market and event management platform
image1Description: Process of designing and developing the Full-stack Platform for the TaladHub system

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: After successfully leading the team into the Top 6 of the Tuek Som Garage project, I drove the project into a full Development Phase under the name 'TaladHub.' My goal was to change the data and solutions gathered from real field work into a Functional Product. This aimed to upgrade market and event management standards to be digital and highly efficient.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I held the roles of both Product Owner (PO) and Developer, defining the Product Roadmap and gathering a skilled development team. I designed and developed the system as a Multi-platform, consisting of a Web Platform for back-end management for market owners and LIFF (LINE Front-end Framework) as the main channel for communication and services for vendors and market visitors. This ensures the system is easy to access and fits real-world usage.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The major challenge was managing resources and time to get a quality product within the competition deadline. I had to make complex technical decisions to ensure system stability and support many users at once. I also had to ensure the User Interface (UI) was easy to learn for diverse user groups, from executives to market vendors. Balancing the required Scope and the limited Timeline was a great test of my project management skills.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: We successfully developed a complete prototype ready for real testing (UAT), which is an important step toward the next competition round. This experience helped me develop Full-stack Developer skills with a big-picture view of the system and Product Owner skills that always consider Business Value. I learned to work with a development team in an Agile format. My greatest pride is seeing an idea that started from zero become a system ready to truly help people in the market industry.
